# Spacing

The decisions behind this page are architecture decision records: see [Decisions](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/md/decisions-all-decisions--overview.md).

Mola UI has no spacing tokens of its own. It uses Tailwind's single spacing unit, `--spacing`, and
every `p-3`, `gap-4` or `mt-6` is a multiple of it. That one decision is what makes density
possible: when a surface sets `data-density`, the unit changes and every gap, padding and margin
inside it changes with it, without a component knowing.

## The scale

A step is a multiple of the unit: `gap-2` is two units, `p-6` is six. The unit is 4px in the
comfortable and spacious densities and 3.5px in compact. The bars below are painted from the live
variable inside each density, and the numbers are read from `tokens.css`.

> Not included in the Markdown version: an interactive `SpacingRuler` block. See it on the page: https://demogar.github.io/molaui/?path=/docs/foundations-spacing--overview

The components lean on a short run of steps. Counted across their source, `2`, `3` and `4` are
used most, then `1` and `1.5` for tight spacing inside controls, and `6` and `8` for the larger
separations between groups. Reach for those before an odd step, and never for an arbitrary value
such as `p-[13px]`: it would not move with density.

## What density sets

Density moves more than the unit. Controls and rows have their own heights, because a button's
height is a touch target and a row's height is a reading rhythm, and neither should be a multiple
of padding that happens to look right. The small end of the type scale moves too, so text keeps
its proportion to the control it sits in. The display end of the scale does not move: a dense tool
is dense in its rows, not its page titles.

> Not included in the Markdown version: an interactive `DensityMetrics` block. See it on the page: https://demogar.github.io/molaui/?path=/docs/foundations-spacing--overview

The comfortable type scale comes from `theme.css`;
the comfortable and spacious spacing unit is Tailwind's default, which Mola does not redeclare.

## How to use it

- **Set density on a surface, not on a component.** `data-density="compact"` on a log panel
  re-scales the table, its toolbar and its filters together. No component takes a density prop.
- **Size controls with the control tokens.** A custom control uses `h-(--control-h)` and
  `px-(--control-px)`, not `h-9 px-3.5`, so it lines up with the buttons and fields beside it in
  every density.
- **Space with steps, not pixels.** Arbitrary values stay the same size when everything around
  them shrinks, which is how a compact screen ends up with one roomy toolbar.
- **Nothing drops below a 24px target or 11px text**, even in compact. If a layout only fits by
  going smaller, the layout is the problem.

The page widths are tokens too: `max-w-page` (1180px) for an application page, `max-w-wide`
(1440px) for a dashboard, and `max-w-prose` (38rem, about 70 characters of Alegreya) for reading.
The prose measure does not change with the viewport or the density.
